revision_basis.diagnosis: Cashahuacra was not generated with Pysheds catchment pour-point semantics. Its frozen delineator (git blob 8b72787b93aafe6c42ed03b3b8af19b01c075658) explicitly built an upstream_mask by reverse traversal of the D8 flow-direction array from the already-frozen outlet row/col. Revision 0.6 incorrectly applied the generic Pysheds replay to Cashahuacra. This revision dispatches routing replay by the immutable geometry-generation provenance recorded in the freeze registry; no morphometric result is used to choose the dispatch.

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.hard_integrity_gate: regenerated DEM GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 for every target before morphometry is accepted

cashahuacra.morphometry_routing_method: reverse D8 distances from the unchanged frozen outlet row/col on the binary-identical geometry-generation DEM; require >=0.995 frozen-polygon routing coverage

unchanged_metric_semantics.polygon_area_and_perimeter: exact frozen polygon projected to EPSG:32718
unchanged_metric_semantics.drainage_density: unchanged threshold and link rule; only qualifying links whose upstream and downstream cells are both inside the frozen-polygon cell-center mask count

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output is frozen by hash
use metric values observed in failed runs to select or tune routing semantics
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
substitute one target's geometry-generation routing semantics for another target's provenance
change DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, channel threshold or metric inclusion rule to improve a result
accept a regenerated DEM whose binary GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
